learning_outcomes.text: Individually define their need for subject-specific deepening and acquisition of extra-curricular competencies.
Plan their competence acquisition by completing suitable courses from the specific catalog of the curriculum and from the central "Transferable Skills" elective catalog of TU Wien.
Compare and select courses from the topic pools Technology for People, Gender Awareness, Language Competence, and Social Competence.
Select courses of at least 9 ECTS from the topic areas of Transferable Skills.
Select courses of at least 3 ECTS from the topic pools Technology Assessment, Technology Genesis, History of Technology, Scientific Ethics, Gender Mainstreaming, and Diversity Management.
Evaluate their competence acquisition after completing courses.
Define personal strengths and development areas for their own competence growth.
Outline an individual learning and time plan to plan free electives and transferable skills as part of their curriculum.
Compare information offers and consulting options and select suitable formats.
Determine the semester workload and available resources for 18 ECTS.
Evaluate their own competence growth with suitable criteria.
